notes.title: Levels and customization return
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
In this small update, levels, portraits, and the name change are returning.
Pretty small for the size of the update, right? Well, there's more coming, Massive bro.
A rework for one of the levels in the game mode Classic is coming soon.
And a new map for [i]Classic mode.[/i]

An issue was also fixed on the [b]Lunari Center[/b] map. When starting a new wave, players would arrive from orbit when reviving. The problem is that the stage is closed, so the player would be left out of the map. This no longer happens.

Killstreaks have been disabled on the [b]Lunari Center[/b] map, since it is closed and no Killstreaks enter the map.

A small cinematic has been added to the Classic map. This adds a precedent to Pixel Troopers levels, making them more immersive and more engaging.

notes.title: Balance Patch/Fixes and Preparations for Pixel Troopers Reloaded
notes.notes:
[p]It's been a while since the last update. And in fact, I thought I'd already updated the game. From what I saw, I left it in a stagnant version. So this quick update fixes the bugs from the previous one and adds some quality of life.[/p][h2]
Corrections:[/h2][p]The Multiplayer section has been removed when entering Single Player. This option is no longer consistent with how you access this menu. It used to make more sense with the previous menu design, which intuitively led you to always navigate to this location. Now, with the current design, it makes no sense or purpose.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/49da60d2790145dab6b9ff8713e95b54948c5316.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Customize Pixel Trooper:[/h2][p]In the latest update, the option to change your Pixel Trooper's color was broken. Now you can go in and change your Pixel Trooper's color. The Load Screen option is still not working, but it will likely be available in the Pixel Troopers Reloaded update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/b7721d20bff644b6d88e53ced5b07caea2b19026.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Replay:[/h2][p]Ever since Pixel Troopers came out, the Record Replays and Replay playback options didn't work. I always found it strange. Well, I can use it from the engine. I thought I did the integration wrong, but it turns out I had to fix a setting that's now deprecated. The result? Replays will now work correctly for the end user.[/p][p]In case you were curious, the structure of a replay is as follows:[/p][p]Replay_day-month-year_Hour-Minute-Second[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/725a91b4744110ce1429d3d9f6e88ef68032f3c0.png"][/img][/p][h2]Search Game:[/h2][p]Fixed a bug where entering and exiting this option would cause the menu to no longer work.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/434cf257223d58092099212816efde5c89efb3e7.png"][/img][/p][h2]Lobby:[/h2][p]The extra settings button that had no function has been removed. This is what I meant when I said I thought I'd already uploaded the update, since I fixed this a long time ago, and based on what I saw in the final game, this element was still there. It seems I never published the update that fixed this bug.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/749e729716c6b0c72eb08c606fe3483286331805.png"][/img][/p][h2]Launch Animation:[/h2][p]In case you didn't know, you can dash by pressing Shift + V. And while I'm still not convinced by the dash animation, it makes more sense now than before.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/c322e4535b47797160f9a3d450998f811e384b3d.png"][/img][/p][p]Especially when you jump and shoot in some direction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/81d205803c18543399ca0a8ce42e573ff9664ad2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Deathmatch & Team Deathmatch:[/h2][p]Modified the Loadout selection layout for these game modes. It's now separated into sections, and while Perks aren't working yet, they'll likely be available in the Pixel Troopers Reloaded update.[/p][p]Added Team 1 and 2 bots for Team Deathmatch; in the near future, these buttons will be automatically removed for the mode they belong to.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/0b789aa0f403cc8334f5ce45ec0904264ac05207.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/883fe16deb351de26c2a57211f54f6b75a5f797a.png"][/img][/p][h2] Quality of life improvements[/h2][p][/p][h2]Shop:[/h2][p]Now, when a player has the Frequent Shopper perk, they'll see a special animation when they enter the store. Make it very clear how your discount benefits them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/3542120646c90128059cfaa770a6cf9e64f084f3.png"][/img][/p][h2]Statistics:[/h2][p]Previously, stats were visible from the player's HUD. It was an option that was there from the very beginning, and I don't remember when it stopped working, but I didn't give it much importance either. At the same time, the defense mechanic went from being a simple Damage - Defense = Final Damage to a slightly more complete formula. Defense has long since ceased to be a statistic that simply subtracts damage, but rather reduces it as a percentage. Moving the stats to the store makes your current status very clear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/87603265d48f2c7f2cbf51cfd9265ad3e98c8389.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Enemy Navigation:[/h2][p]Previously, enemies would often get stuck in places where they should have been able to dash to avoid a path. While building the adventure levels, which will likely be coming in Pixel Troopers Reloaded, these issues became very noticeable, preventing my adventure levels from running correctly. After much research, I managed to fix it. While enemies like the Zombie may still have this bug, it will be fixed in a future update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/d9feabf2c29104218838ca68dec034a55e2091b6.png"][/img][/p][h2]Start of game:[/h2][p]There was a lot of criticism about the game's start. Many say it starts too quickly and the enemies are too strong for just the first wave. So I decided to modify the waves. Now, the first wave will start with weaker enemies and in much smaller numbers, then it will normalize. And although the game still starts quickly (I'll be making the waves take longer to start soon), I now find the game easier to understand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/21e028cf42818593c528c1c0208544800c6923fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Well, I hope I'm not forgetting anything. I think that's all I can show you, as that's what this update brings. More content coming soon! New levels and adventures await you. See you next time! Bye bye.[/p]

notes.title: Little Bug Fixes!!!!
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that occurred when changing the game quality, some "Textures" would turn into gray boxes.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added an animation when using the Frequent Buyer perk.
[*] Changed music priority to reduce the issue where the music would stop playing when the sound channels ran out.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented breaking the entrance door despite the feature being added.
[*] Increased core health on the Classic map from 10,000 to 40,000.
[*] Changed the Classic map to start directly from the helicopter with the E key, making it more inmersive to enter.
[*] Added three new music tracks for the Pixel Troopers gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: General Update 10-7-25
notes.notes: [p]Hello! I'll be direct, these are the changes in the update.[/p][h2]New MENU[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/3b9e01470d79cc2deaef808fa7815542949b496d.png"][/img]You may notice that some features are unavailable. They will be integrated over time. I wanted to rebuild the menu because the previous design not only wasn't fully functional with a controller, but also didn't provide a unique identity like Pixel Troopers.[/p][p]This design is very simplified and functional with both keyboard and mouse. It also makes it more consistent with the art used to promote the game.[/p][p]Note: Some features may revert to the old menu, if this is the case. Please notify me so I can fix it.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Game Mode: Team Deathmatch[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/ab790271258552ac8e4f1935440e410d4b885574.png"][/img][/p][p]Although I forgot to mark it as active, Team Deathmatch is now available. You can create a game with this mode by going to Multiplayer > Create Game > and choosing the game mode you want, then going to Game Mode and changing it to Team Deathmatch.[/p][p][/p][h2]Changes in quality of life[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/81308c6b7316b68c40ae415522a1d11153980c1a.png"][/img]Added a button to invite friends in the Multiplayer Lobby. I heard it was quite awkward/confusing when inviting Steam friends to a multiplayer lobby.[/p][p]So I simplified it by adding an invite friend button that will open the Steam interface.[/p][p]You may have already noticed the new button there. It was for testing purposes; it will be removed later.[/p][p][/p][h2]Loading Screens: Seamless Travel[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/6eded0ac326560ca55d56b59f3a5e937ce928c0f.png"][/img]Enable Seamless Travel in multiplayer games. To give a more immersive effect. Now, when starting a multiplayer game, the loading screens will transition to a clean game, instead of abruptly skipping, giving a more immersive effect. The Cancel Load buttons are still being implemented; sometimes they will work correctly. Other times, they may not do anything.[/p][p][/p][h2]Melee: Major Modifications[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/1b000286269154322327e404f24a0bbf4c56eca8.png"][/img]I listened to the feedback on melee, it's surprisingly the favorite class xD. So I started working on it first. It already suffered a nerf.[/p][list][*][p]The class started with 25% damage reduction, now I've lowered it to 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]The class's base speed and dash speed have been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]New attack animations[/p][/*][*][p]The Vampirisk perk now works correctly when attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]The Search Debility perk now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Impatient Critical perk now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented melee attacks from dealing damage unless the player is in the Servant's field of view.[/p][/*][*][p]New Rage Ability: The Melee draws the attention of all insects on the map to attack it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Flamethrower: Fixed[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/a1b90d132e5403dc3b12b319127732325e038013.png"][/img]The flamethrower was a weapon that stopped working when the game was heavily optimized. I was finally able to fix its bugs and adapt it to the new system. Yes, I forgot to disable its hitbox display, and yes. That's its hitbox. XD[/p][p][/p][h2]Perk: Human Cannon[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/de0dfbb82a3831ffaf9423d8a6ee7e61b5fcb942.png"][/img]While the perk's name still doesn't convince me, I finally added an effect so you can really feel what the perk does. Before, I didn't add anything, which gave a strange feeling when you hit the ground; most of the time, you forgot you had that perk. Now, with this effect, you can see what it does and get an idea of ​​its range.[/p][p][/p][h2]Color:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/1aa0100cac0072c8e278f564d6029a8f373ea694.png"][/img][/p][p]Although you could also change the color of your pixel trooper before, I find it has a more immersive effect now.[/p][p][/p][h2]BETA[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665137/261f0faafd39cbe9d0d6008657c36f247017d9e8.png"][/img]You may have noticed this Add Local Player button; it's currently in experimental mode. I'm not sure how well everything works, but it's useful if you need to get out of trouble. Feel free to report any bugs you find![/p][p][/p][p]Well, those are most of the changes. More changes coming soon![/p][p]See you later.[/p]
